evidence.claim: The controlled returning workspace was contained for login and view inspection.
readbacks: Login and view access remained available in the controlled workspace.
The current production revision was healthy and held sole 100 percent serving traffic.
Finish-line product send and index counters reconciled at 7/7.
The queue drained with zero scoped residue, zero application errors, and zero 5xx responses.
Controls read back Closed/Closed, the exact client was paused outside deliberate admission, and no send-capable residue remained in the audited workspace scope.
limitations: No campaign launch or send was exercised by this readback.

evidence.claim: One controlled ten-row launch completed with unique initial sends and indexes, reconciled counters, queue drain, and zero scoped residue.
readbacks: Ten unique initial sends and ten unique indexes were observed.
The scoped queue drained, counters reconciled, and zero scoped residue remained.
limitations: This was one controlled launch and does not prove follow-ups, copied-party threads, complex extraction, or broad rollout.

evidence.claim: Five simple or correction extraction rows closed with same-row formulas and no repeated ask observed.
readbacks: Five simple or correction rows closed with formulas on their original rows.
No repeated ask was observed in those five rows.
limitations: The rows do not prove ambiguous multi-suite documents, hard repeat suppression, autoresponders, or long conversations.

evidence.claim: Two unavailable rows reached terminal state with follow-ups stopped.
readbacks: Two unavailable rows were terminalized.
Follow-ups were stopped for both rows.
limitations: This does not prove autonomous follow-up scheduling or other terminal scenarios.

evidence.claim: The monitored returning-user canary completed a full-spec close and a partial-then-correction flow with targeted missing-field handling, correction precedence, terminal closure, exact same-row updates, reconciled counters, and zero scoped residue.
readbacks: Row 8 closed after one full-spec reply without another ask.
Row 9 remained active after partial facts and the automatic response requested only operating expenses.
Row 9 accepted the correction plus operating expenses, replaced the earlier Total SF value, preserved Rent/SF/Yr, and reached terminal closure without another ask.
Sheet Row 8 read back Total SF 21,600, Rent/SF/Yr 17.25, Ops Ex/SF 4.10, and same-row formula G8*(H8+I8)/12 with result 38,430.00.
Sheet Row 9 read back corrected Total SF 47,900, Rent/SF/Yr 15.35, Ops Ex/SF 3.85, and same-row formula G9*(H9+I9)/12 with result 76,640.00.
The dashboard showed both target rows completed at the end, and every other campaign row was unchanged.
Automatic-send and message-index counters reconciled at 20/20.
Action, pending, reconciliation, duplicate, error, dead-letter, claim, task, and scoped-residue readbacks were zero.
Campaign controls read back Closed/Closed with queued, blocked, pending, dead-letter, stopping, and stop-failed counts all zero.
Production revision process-user-00092-som reported 100 percent health with zero application errors and zero 5xx responses.
limitations: The proof covered two controlled rows and three broker-side replies; it does not prove long conversations, ambiguous history, or every correction shape.
No copied-party CC thread, attachment or ambiguous multi-suite PDF, autoresponder, autonomous follow-ups, or unattended campaign was exercised.
No hard rejection case was induced; targeted missing-field handling and one correction were observed, so hard repeat-ask suppression remains partial.

Functional closure was safe, but natural voice is not cleared: one close contained jammed punctuation and stock follow-up phrasing, while the final close used a spaced hyphen and familiar stock phrasing.
The campaign launch itself remains supported by separate controlled launch evidence.

evidence.claim: One monitored copied-party reply preserved the exact safe audience, extracted the supplied facts, updated only the bound Sheet row, and closed terminally with zero scoped residue.
readbacks: The automatic response used the canonical To, preserved exactly one safe copied Cc, and Bcc was empty; no product self, alias, duplicate, or unknown audience was present.
The Sheet read back Total SF 52,400, Rent/SF/Yr 14.80, Ops Ex/SF 3.95, the same-row formula preserved, and Gross 81,875.00.
The row reached terminal completion with follow-ups stopped, no other-row delta, reconciled send and index counts, and zero scoped residue.
limitations: This proves one controlled copied-party shape, not arbitrary participant graphs, blocked-party filtering combinations, cross-tenant use, or autonomous follow-ups.
Naturalness and punctuation remain nonblocking quality observations unless wording changes meaning or requests a known field.

evidence.claim: The copied-party live proof carries forward to the current release because the intervening fix was attachment-only and did not touch the exercised reply-all, recipient, send, extraction, or Sheet paths.
readbacks: The intervening source delta was attachment-only and limited to coalescing ambiguous attachment review actions.
The delta did not touch reply-all routing, recipient filtering, outbound send, fact extraction, same-row Sheet update, lifecycle terminalization, or the copied-party scenario contract.
The preceding live copied-party proof remains separately attributed to its actual release identity.

It carries forward only the exact copied-party scenario and does not broaden participant, cross-tenant, autonomous-followup, or recovery claims.

evidence.claim: One monitored mixed-property PDF failed closed after a clean post-fix retry, producing exactly one review action and no send, counter, fact, asset, or Sheet mutation.
readbacks: One inbound index produced exactly one proposal audit and exactly one review action with reason multi_property_attachment while the active lifecycle remained paused.
The clean retry produced zero automatic sends or indexes, zero terminal closes, and zero counter delta.
The target and every other row had zero fact, zero asset, and zero Sheet change; formula, provenance, and preexisting values remained intact.

The initial attempt triggered a duplicate-action hard stop; fix commit 62a7d59 coalesced the review action, and the clean retry passed on the deployed candidate with zero duplicate, reconciliation, failure, or queue residue.
limitations: The initial duplicate-action attempt is invalidated evidence; only the clean post-fix retry supports this pass.
This proves fail-closed handling for one controlled mixed-property ambiguity shape, not broad PDF extraction quality or every attachment layout.

evidence.claim: One monitored 13-message conversation preserved correction precedence and chronological ordering through a call-request pause, Dashboard continuation, exact missing-field asks, terminal close, and idempotent replay.
readbacks: The settled 13-message spine contained one baseline outbound, six controlled inbounds, one Dashboard continuation, and five automatic responses; product send and index counters increased by exactly six.

The call request produced one pause and one call action with zero automatic send; the monitored Dashboard continuation resolved the call action, resumed the thread, and asked only the exact missing fields.
Every later automatic response requested only the exact missing fields, never repeated a known field, and retained chronological context and both corrections.
The Sheet read back final Total SF 40,800, Rent/SF/Yr 15.10, Ops Ex/SF 3.75, the same-row formula preserved, and Gross 64,090.00 before one terminal close.
All product outbounds used the canonical audience with Cc and Bcc empty; no other-row delta, duplicate, or scoped residue remained.
One ordinary worker cycle after settlement was an idempotent replay with zero send, index, counter, fact, asset, lifecycle, action, or Sheet delta.
limitations: The replay proves settled-event idempotence, not uncertain-provider send recovery, dead-letter recovery, or autonomous follow-ups.
The proof covers one controlled ordering and correction spine; it does not prove arbitrary long conversations, simultaneous campaigns, multirow use, or cross-tenant use.
Natural voice remains open and nonblocking; the pass is limited to semantic correctness, groundedness, and exact missing-field behavior.
